description: This file contains utility functions and error mappings for the v3rpc package of etcd, including error conversion, context error checking, and learner RPC support.

methods.name: togRPCError
methods.description: Converts internal errors to gRPC errors with appropriate codes.

methods.name: isClientCtxErr
methods.description: Checks if an error is due to client context cancellation or timeout.

methods.name: isRPCSupportedForLearner
methods.description: Determines if a request is supported for learner nodes.
